## Description

Per doctor and period: gross, discounts, refunds, net (= gross − discounts − refunds), insurer receivable counted when settled, payout share per doctor (configured in Settings → Doctors), payout amount. Admin only; export CSV.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Net and payout figures reconcile with invoices/payments for the period.
- [ ] **AC2.** Only practice admins can view (403 for others).
- [ ] **AC3.** Payout share changes are versioned by effective date.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
